class.name: NNBTBlackboardSet
class.brief_description: Writes a value into the behaviour tree blackboard.
class.description: Stores [member value] under [member key] in the effective [NNBlackboard] of the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor. Returns [code]SUCCESS[/code] when the value was stored, including when the value is [code]null[/code]. Returns [code]FAILURE[/code] for an empty [member key], when there is no [NNBTRoot] ancestor with a blackboard, or when the write is rejected. Configuration errors are reported once per node instance, naming the class, node name and location, and the node returns [code]FAILURE[/code] without coercing anything. This leaf is fully data-driven: it is configured entirely by its properties, does not call and is not affected by an [code]on_tick[/code] override in an attached script, and works on the effective [NNBlackboard] of the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor through the [NoodleNodes] blackboard helpers.

members.member: The blackboard key to write. Must be non-empty; an empty key reports an error once and returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE].
The value to store. Any [Variant] type is allowed, including [code]null[/code].
